summary: Tested Phase-65 'Two-Way Sensitivity — Heir Rate x Market Regime' end-to-end. Backend: new pytest HTTP suite (12 tests) against the public ingress with a master token — contract (rates/rate_labels/6 regimes/6x6 matrix/per-regime break_even/verbatim caption), caching idempotency, auth gate (401) and junk-config rejection (400) all pass except one break-even edge case. Frontend: found and reproduced a CRITICAL React crash ('onTwoWayResult is not defined') that blanked the whole Monte Carlo tab after every MC run; applied the minimal in-scope prop fix and then verified the in-app heat-grid panel and the printed report page fully (labels, 6 regime columns with custom excluded, 36 colored cells, break-even row with extrapolated flags, verbatim caption, re-run/cache, page ordering + numbering + no page overflow). Regression: MC regime comparison (6 rows) + deterministic regime table (6 rows) and the Heir Rate Sensitivity report page still render.

minor.issue: lost_decade column is identically $0 at every heir rate (with- and no-conversion heir outcomes are the same $4,052,162 and rate-invariant), and _break_even_from_points returns rate=0.0 with extrapolated=false for that flat column. A hard '0.0%' break-even is misleading for a surface where conversion changes nothing — expected null (n/a) or extrapolated=true. Repro: POST /api/two-way-sensitivity with the default scenario; test_iter31_two_way_http.py::test_flat_column_break_even fails.

Stale regression test: tests/test_iter30_regime_det_http.py::test_response_shape asserts 7 rows but the endpoint now excludes the 'custom' preset and returns 6. Either update that assertion or restore the custom row (behaviour decision — left untouched).

ui_bugs.issue: CRITICAL (fixed in-test-scope): 'ReferenceError: onTwoWayResult is not defined' — line 670 passes onResult={onTwoWayResult} but the component signature (line 60) never destructured that prop and Planner.jsx (line 440) never passes it. Result: an uncaught runtime error blanked the ENTIRE Monte Carlo tab immediately after any MC run (existing MC results, regime panel and the new panel all gone). I added onTwoWayResult to the destructured props to unblock testing; main agent must decide whether to thread the result into Planner state (like onRegimeResult) or drop the prop.

Exact-tie cells (delta = 0, whole lost_decade column '+$0') are painted with the AMBER hue (delta > 0 is false), implying 'not converting wins' for a tie, and are prefixed '+'. Consider a neutral/uncolored treatment for 0.
lost_decade shows '0.0%' with no 'extrapolated' flag for an all-zero column (see backend minor issue) — reads as a firm break-even.

rca_of_the_issue: MonteCarlo.jsx line 670 renders <TwoWaySensitivityPanel onResult={onTwoWayResult}> but onTwoWayResult was never added to the component's destructured props (line 60) nor passed by Planner.jsx, so evaluating the JSX threw a ReferenceError during render of the {res && ...} branch — i.e. on every completed Monte Carlo run — collapsing the whole tab to the CRA runtime-error overlay. Adding the prop name to the signature makes it undefined-safe (the panel calls onResult?.(res)). Separately, the lost_decade all-zero column exposes a logic gap in _break_even_from_points: a zero-span segment satisfies the (d0 <= 0 <= d1) crossover test, so it returns the lower rate (0.0) flagged as non-extrapolated instead of n/a.
